_comment: Project-specific configuration for issue creation, label seeding, and triage.
ACTIVE scope only: ticket, agent, customer, team (all DynamoDB) + auth (Cognito).
knowledge-base is a STRETCH domain (documented only, deferred) and is intentionally NOT listed here.
1. Edit `domains[]` to match your bounded contexts.
2. Edit `crossCutting[]` only if you add front-end or infra surfaces.
4. Keep the `Domain` dropdown in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.yml` in sync (no dynamic dropdowns in GitHub forms).
NOTE: each `description` becomes a GitHub label description and MUST be ≤ 100 characters
(hard limit enforced by the GitHub REST API — longer values are rejected with HTTP 422).

crossCutting.description: Spans 2+ bounded contexts (sync ACL or async saga)
